stay.price_basis: VARANASI city figures used as the base for Sarnath (about 10 km; most visitors stay in Varanasi and go out for 3-4 hours); mid: Cleartrip 3-star page, stay 13-14 Nov 2026 (Fri-Sat), 1 room 2 guests, discounted sale price before taxes; 16 3-star rows (4-star Castillo 8,400 and the 882 guest house excluded), range 1,943 to 6,915; budget: Cleartrip budget page, stay 11-12 Oct 2026 (Sun-Mon), 1 room 2 guests, price before taxes where a tax line is shown (some rows do not say); 20 rows, range 350 to 1,904 (ghat-area guest houses mostly 350-1,000 with a few at 1,456-1,747; city-centre and Bhelupur hotels mostly 1,500-1,900); homestay: Cleartrip homestay page, stay 13-14 Nov 2026, before taxes; 12 rows typed homestay, range 861 to 4,969; dorm: Hostelworld 'dorms from' (cheapest bed per hostel, no stay date shown); 27 hostels, range 249 to 799
stay.notes: Sarnath has its own small lodging (Cleartrip lists Raj Shanti Guest House Sarnath at 1,400 on 11-12 Oct; Wikivoyage's Sarnath page, updated Feb 2026, quotes Tara Temple rooms at 600 shared bath to 900-1,000 private bath, plus Golden Buddha Hotel 400-1,200 undated). Fern Residency Sarnath is the only branded property but had no price. Too few to take a median, so the Varanasi base is reported. Varanasi's own stay was measured separately by the project.

taxi_day.basis: Sarnath is a 3-4 hour trip from Varanasi (about 10 km), so a sedan hired for the Varanasi 8hr/80km package (Dzire 1,800 Banaras Taxi, 2,000 Varanasi Cab, median 1,900) covers it. Wikivoyage's Sarnath page (updated April 2023): auto 700 return including an hour's wait, taxi over 1,500 return; local bus 107E 25. The Varanasi page (undated) says 500 return by auto with a 1-2 hour wait. All Sarnath-only fares are 2023 or undated.
taxi_day.notes: Neither operator lists a Sarnath package by name. Auto is the common way to reach Sarnath, so 500-700 return is the traveller-relevant number but it is dated; treat as low confidence.

food_per_person_day.basis: PROXY: Varanasi figures (Zomato, above), since Sarnath is a 3-4 hour visit from Varanasi and has no Zomato dining listing found. One Sarnath data point: Tara Temple (Wikivoyage Sarnath page, updated Feb 2026) quotes Tibetan/Indian breakfast or dinner at 100 and lunch at 200 per person, i.e. about 400 for a day of simple temple meals.
food_per_person_day.notes: Most visitors eat in Varanasi; the Sarnath temple-guesthouse meal price suggests a genuine budget day is well below 700.
